status.nb: 59 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 33 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Kabul og Peshawar.

summary.en: Security forces in Balochistan carried out intelligence-based operations that neutralised twelve militants, while separate encounters in Punjab left three people dead. A gas cylinder explosion in Dera Ismail Khan killed two cousins, and a building collapse in Karachi caused four deaths and left seventeen missing. A shipwreck off Libya claimed the lives of residents from Pakistan's Bajaur district. The conflict produced 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker i Balochistan gjennomførte etterretningsbaserte operasjoner som nøytraliserte tolv militante, mens separate sammenstøt i Punjab førte til tre døde. En gassylinderexplosjon i Dera Ismail Khan drepte to søsken, og et bygningskollaps i Karachi forårsaket fire dødsfall og etterlot sytten savnet. Et skipsforlis utenfor Libya krevde livet til innbyggere fra Pakistans Bajaur-distrikt. Konflikten førte til 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
